name: Behind the Sanguine Curtain
source:
You play as the pretentious high school student council president, Sachihiro Kurusawa, as he tours a new transfer student from France! He is shy around you, but seems oddly attached nonetheless. Despite this, things quickly begin going downhill as he grows closer with you and as you interact with those around you.

[From [url=https://mushsky.itch.io/behind-the-sanguine-curtain]Itch.io[/url]]
